executive_summary: Six Birds Theory (SBT) is a finite, audited closure/emergence calculus. Honestly scored across 32 physics-facing retrodiction candidates, it retrodicts NOTHING new: every physics-facing result is a RECOVERY, REORGANIZATION, or HONEST NEGATIVE of standard mathematics/physics, with all empirically decisive content (Born weights, pointer basis, single outcome, the gauge group, the matter spectrum, the cosmological measure) imported or explicitly disclaimed. What SBT can honestly offer: (1) faithful, often Lean-certified STRUCTURAL NORMAL FORMS that re-express textbook facts as instances of a small set of closure primitives, and (2) a falsification-first AUDIT DISCIPLINE (no false arrows, no fake force, no closed-macro-law-without-checking-CD). The genuine selling point is CROSS-DOMAIN MECHANISM REUSE: four mechanisms (idempotent-packaging, route-mismatch, audit-DPI/cycle-affinity, orbit-descent) each fire across multiple physics domains, compressing apparently unrelated facts. The 3-4 flagship arguments are all structural and disclaimer-respecting: R001 (collapse = idempotent P5 packaging closure; dephasing fixed points = diagonal record states, Lean-certified at matrix level); R028 (one audit-monotonicity contract recovers classical path-KL DPI and quantum relative-entropy DPI); R024 (clean, verbatim-verified honest NEGATIVE: SBT contains zero spin-statistics/generation machinery); and the route-mismatch family (R009 LES subgrid stress as an exact identity, anchoring R027's cross-domain diagnostic). What SBT CANNOT honestly retrodict: any quantitative constant, the Born rule, single-outcome collapse, a preferred basis, dark-energy magnitude, neutrino-sector physics, or anything requiring a continuum/Lorentz/Fock interface. Numerical-constant matches (R014, R025, R032) and disclaimer-crossing readings must be down-ranked or avoided. The Atlas is a credibility map, not a marketing document.

parameter_accounting_summary: The corpus-wide honest read is that SBT's overfitting risk is NOT classical curve-fitting of constants (most cards match exact-zero null gates or analytic identities with zero or two data points) but LENS-SELECTION FREEDOM plus IMPORT. Three free-parameter classes dominate. (1) The lens f / pointer basis / record algebra is an undetermined input with NO selection rule (ledger missing_interfaces #1; disclaimers: pointer-basis selection explicitly disclaimed). Because the lens is free, the opposite-world test passes for almost every card (opposite_world_elastic=true for 28 of 32): the framework reorganizes whatever partition/basis/group is handed to it and forbids no outcome. (2) The completion U_f / prototypes (uniform, Maxwellian, Gaussian, one-hot, max-entropy) are SELECTED not unique, and for LES there is NO canonical U at all. (3) The declared substrate data in Foundations IV laws (symmetry group, future-probe family, measure record, budgets) inject whatever physics is smuggled into the declaration. Where overfitting concentrates: the THREE numerical-constant cards. R025 (Omega_Lambda=0.602429) has ~12 tunable knobs against ~1 chosen target value and is openly synthetic; R032 (m_nu direction) has ~9 choices against 1 EXTERNAL matched fact; R010 (shadow price) has ~10 structural choices including the load-bearing cost matrix against ~2 matched facts. By contrast the skeptic-resistant cards (R024 none, R028 low/inelastic, R016/R015 low, R009 low/inelastic) have essentially zero fitting freedom because they match inequalities or identities that MUST hold. The decisive honesty discipline: every card must carry (a) a null-gate control value, (b) an explicit imported-vs-recovered ledger, and (c) the statement that the matched target is identically zero / forced / external where that is true. The aggregate verdict: SBT cannot overfit a constant it does not produce, but it can ACCOMMODATE almost any structure via lens/declaration freedom, so its honest scientific value is in the rigid, lens-independent inequalities and identities, not in any 'match'.

completeness_critique: This Atlas inherits limits from its inputs and method. (1) UNVERIFIED ARTIFACTS: many Lean lemmas and Python scripts are cited by identifier from .tex sources; the cards flag (e.g. R004) that zero .lean files and zero Python exhibits were independently confirmed in the corpus snapshot for several cards, so 'Lean-certified' rests on the cards' own verification logs, not a fresh build here. A reviewer should re-run the named modules (QuantumDephase.lean, RouteMismatch.lean, tvdist_pushforward_le, six-birds-randomness, sbtq, six-birds-protocol-trap, six-birds-time, six-birds-layer-birth). (2) SCORES NOT RECOMPUTED: per instructions the composite scores were used as given; if the formula weights or skeptic panel were miscalibrated, the ranking shifts. (3) TARGETS NOT COVERED: the 32 candidates are a curated set; obvious physics retrodiction targets with NO SBT contact were largely surfaced only via the honest-negative R024 (statistics/generations). Other untouched targets that SBT structurally CANNOT reach but that a hostile reviewer will ask about: particle mass ratios, coupling-constant running, CKM/PMNS mixing, the fine-structure constant, blackbody/Planck spectrum, the Hubble tension magnitude, the muon g-2, neutrino oscillation parameters, and any S-matrix/scattering observable. None are addressable; the Atlas should state this rather than imply the 32 exhaust the space. (4) MODALITIES NOT RUN: no fresh adversarial red-team beyond the frozen four-skeptic panel; no out-of-sample / pre-registration test of any 'match' (all matched data are frozen calibration/regression certificates of identities that must hold); no sensitivity analysis on the lens-selection freedom that drives the opposite-world elasticity. (5) WHERE THIS ANALYSIS COULD BE WRONG: the cross-domain mechanism-reuse framing is the most flattering honest reading, but a harsher reviewer could argue it is a SINGLE trivial fact (linear algebra noncommutation; monotone divergences; quotient-by-fibers) wearing six costumes, in which case 'six mechanisms across many domains' collapses to 'three textbook lemmas relabeled', further deflating the unification selling point. The Atlas foregrounds reuse as a strength while disclosing this deflation; readers should weigh both. (6) DISCLAIMER DRIFT: several cards (R013 Loschmidt/Second-Law, R014/R023 thermodynamic framing, R025 dark energy) carry framings the source papers do NOT contain; the Atlas relies on the repair stage having stripped these, but residual drift is possible.
